motto: Serving Greywater Falls since 1887, and the lake somewhat longer.
weather: Clear and cold, 22°F, wind easing out of the west, no new snow

undercurrent.phenomenon: The season's rituals have fully dissolved into habit; the town carries its difference between sign and census the way it carries anything it loves without needing to name it daily.
undercurrent.note: One day from coda. Eased level to 14, held stage 2 as instructed for the final pre-coda day. Closed Calloway's card thread (card returned to its place, face down, unresolved identity left gently unresolved per directive not to over-close the mystery itself, only the town's relationship to it). Teased Wren's second notebook payoff explicitly for tomorrow. Agnes given her single word ('settled') as the near-final beat before full retirement from riddling tomorrow. Gerald's arc fully closed tonight ('held' twice, final entry declared). Saved full sign/count reaffirmation and closing image for the coda lead tomorrow as planned.

editor.name: Wren Aldercott
editor.voice: Dry, precise, allergic to drama, which is unfortunate given recent events. Writes like a person holding a clipboard while standing in rising water. Lets one true thing slip per edition, usually in the last line.

season_arc.premise: Calloway finishes reshelving the east alcove in the last cataloguer's 2009 order and finds, tucked behind where the ninth book sat, a library card checked out that same interrupted Wednesday and never returned. It is due back today. The borrower's name is nobody currently living in Greywater Falls has ever heard of, and the little pocket calendar stamped inside has fourteen years of due-date stamps on it already, one for every year since, each in a different hand.
